blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — Cade Cunningham scored 26 points, and John Collins had 16 points and 11 rebounds to help the Detroit Pistons stay unbeaten with a 106-93 win over LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers on Sunday night. The Pistons improved to 3-0 in their first game without All-Star center Jalen Duren, who will miss at least two weeks with a strained right hamstring. Duren was injured in the first half of Detroit’s win over Miami on Friday. The Pistons led wire-to-wire against a 76ers team playing on the second night of a back-to-back and missing starters Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe. […]...
